params.command: $repo = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'; $ac = Join-Path $repo 'tools\agent-control'; Set-Location $repo; git fetch origin main --prune; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $branch = (git branch --show-current).Trim(); if ($branch -ne 'main') { Write-Error "Canonical checkout is on $branch, expected main"; exit 20 }; $dirty = git status --porcelain; if ($dirty) { Write-Error 'Canonical checkout is dirty; refusing destructive deployment'; $dirty; exit 21 }; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $head = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if ($head -ne 'f238c429193d037343b0b060ba2e1c06587d5284') { Write-Error "Unexpected main HEAD $head"; exit 22 }; $targets = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'tools[\\/]agent-control[\\/]server\.mjs' -or (($_.CommandLine -match 'server\.mjs') -and ($_.ExecutablePath -match 'node')) }; foreach ($p in $targets) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700; $env:AGENT_CONTROL_REPO = $repo; Start-Process -FilePath 'node' -ArgumentList 'server.mjs' -WorkingDirectory $ac -WindowStyle Minimized; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $status = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:7331/api/status' -TimeoutSec 10; $version = (Get-Content (Join-Path $ac 'package.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version; git push origin --delete fix/agent-control-no-work-recovery-20260929 2>$null; Write-Output (ConvertTo-Json @{ head=$head; version=$version; status=$status; deleted_branch=($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) } -Depth 8 -Compress); exit 0
